chunks: Al-‘Abbās ibn Ma‘rūf, and from Wahb ibn Wahb, from Abī ‘Abdillāh عليه السلام, who said:

Indeed, the Messenger of Allah صلى الله عليه وآله prayed over a جنازة. When he had finished, some people came to him and said: O Messenger of Allah, we did not catch the prayer over it. So he said: A funeral is not prayed over twice, but supplicate for it.

key_terms.جِنَازَةٍ: a funeral bier or deceased person for whom funeral rites are performed
key_terms.رَسُولَ اللَّهِ: the Messenger of Allah صلى الله عليه وآله
key_terms.لَهَا: for her/it, meaning for the funeral or the deceased

ai.seo_question: Can salat over a جنازة be repeated if someone missed it?
ai.summary: This hadith relates that after the Messenger of Allah صلى الله عليه وآله had performed the funeral prayer, some people arrived late and asked about praying over the deceased. He replied that the funeral prayer is not to be repeated twice, and that they should instead make du'a for the deceased.
